capabilities: Capture text via command or ribbon icon into the daily note
Append captures under a chosen heading
Create the daily note if it does not exist
Classify captures into headings with a configured AI endpoint
extras: Privacy note: in default mode nothing leaves the vault; AI classification sends the capture text to a user-configured endpoint.
intentEvidence: Quickly capture a thought and file it into today's daily note under the right heading.
problem: Obsidian's daily notes workflow lacks a fast way to file a captured thought under the right heading in today's note.
summary: Quick-capture tool that appends thoughts into today's daily note under the appropriate heading, with optional AI classification.
